searchText: There’s still eth2-launchpad. Is it too clumsy to have the category name be "eth-execution" rather than "ethX"? I was a fan of terseness until recently. Even though they're *just* channel names it seems wiser to have the terminology here align with what we'd want the community to see: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/598292067260825641/844761091220832256 because the launchpad is called "Eth2 Launchpad" 😅 Eth2 is a version of Ethereum with PoS and Shards, right? I have a vague suspicion that people want to avoid the term eth2 for possible tax reasons. To my mind the fear that people may think it's a different token is not that important. There are millions of ways people get conned anyway I don't think this is at all the reason. It's more like, eth2 used to be part of a specific roadmap at some point in time but now that roadmap has significantly changed and the planned staged releases don't reflect anymore the original idea of the upgrade Yeah but it's widely adopted to mean the token that is held on validators balances Well, I would disagree with that, for me ETH2 referred to a protocol significant protocol upgrade, and there's no distinction between the tokens. The ETH held on validator balances is ETH. It's fine to call it whatever people decide, I don't mind, but I myself don't see it too bad to be eth2 It's a communication issue, a number of people have the expectation that eth2 means lower gas fees, scalability, sharding, you name it, and that all of that will happen at the same time in a big release called "eth2" and at that point everyone will be happy even if it was the case at some point, it isn't now, and people are seeking to clear that confusion eth0 sounds the best
